description:
Turn your voice into polished text.

Ultra-fast AI powered dictation that understands what you want to say and how you want to say it. Instantly turn speech into perfect emails, crisp notes, clear messages, professional communication, and more.
## Features
- Added Cohere Transcribe model with Vocabulary support via our new Supervocab engine
- Added sound effect theme selection
- Added proxy support (WPAD and PAC)
- Added `record/start` and `record/stop` deep links for controlling recording from external tools
## Improvements
- Model selector now has arrow-key navigation
- Models that your system can't run are no longer available to download
- Updated the history info drawer UI
- Updated the reprocess button and its popout
- Experimental feature icons now sit beside their toggles and light up when active
- Added hover states to the vocabulary input buttons
- Improved model dependency system
## Fixes
- Fixed Settings window drag in history item full-view
- Fixed "popular" model options
- Fixed history transcript copying (full, segmented, and speaker-formatted output)
- Fixed sound effects toggle not being respected at launch
- Fixed the help message icon position
- Fixed escape key navigation when in history item full-view with info drawer open
- Fixed history info drawer timestamp format
- Fix cohere auto language detection
